pages.text: $(o)Undead of the soul sand valleys.$()$(br2)$(l)Gifts$()$(li)10% of the damage you deal heals you.$(li)+20% Rage power.$(li)Monsters notice you later.

$(l)Abilities$()$(li)$(k:key.neoorigins.skill_1): Raise Dead (2 min): two skeleton warriors fight for you for 30 seconds.$(li)$(k:key.neoorigins.skill_2): Feign Death (90 s): turn invisible; every creature after you loses track of you.$(br2)$(l)Drawbacks$()$(li)All healing you receive is 30% weaker.
